FN-LLHXAAW-3
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 226
Committee: Transportation, Utilities and Sponsor: Senator Gerald Allen
Infrastructure
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 05/03/2024
Senate Bill 226 as passed the Senate would prohibit any state or local entity from imposing a
tax on the operation of certain automated driving vehicles. This bill would not otherwise affect
state or local funding.
